items.event_time_ist: Denials and fact-checks published Oct 11-12, 2026; Talarico off trail Sept 26-Oct 9, 2026
items.title: Viral claim that Talarico was treated at an Ohio mental-health facility debunked (TX Senate)
items.summary: Texas Democrat James Talarico was off the campaign trail Sept 26-Oct 9 with what he and his campaign said was the flu (diagnosed Sept 30 after a Dallas urgent-care visit). Right-wing influencers claimed he had checked into Ohio's Lindner Center of Hope, including audio of a purported phone call with a staffer. The facility issued a formal denial Oct 11: Talarico 'has never received treatment from Lindner Center of Hope'; Talarico replied he has 'never even been to Ohio'; NYT reported campaign-provided security footage showed him at his Austin home Oct 1-8; PolitiFact rated the claim 'Pants on Fire'. Paxton had demanded 'proof of life' and a doctor's note; Trump mocked the absence at his Oct 7 San Antonio rally. Talarico returned Oct 9 at Austin City Limits and told KXAS Oct 11 it was 'a nasty case of the flu'. Polls still show Talarico leading Paxton narrowly (RCP avg Talarico +2.8).
